### LOW: Public cluster qualification extended to any Apple silicon pair on owner decision, beyond evidence placement
[docs/architecture/inference\.md:5275](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/2071bbd79fe1ab24d49c8ce1321afe98c3d8989b/docs/architecture/inference.md#L5275) · T-054, T-055, T-056

The updated docs and changelog say GLM\-5\.3\-Flash and Qwen3\.8\-27B are declared for public cluster traffic in pipeline and tensor parallel\. A coordinator derives their qualifications from a checked\-in declaration \(\`ClusterPublicModels\`\) and applies them to the whole declared family "on any Apple silicon pair", because "the placement names the evidence, not a limit"\. The changelog admits that no pipeline ran on two M5 Ultras and that GLM\-5\.3\-Flash has no tensor\-parallel cross\-cable record, so both rest on the owner's decision\. Pair members report only hardware capabilities, so a grant is the only gate on who may serve consumer prompts\. A provider \(ADV\-001\) with a different chip or memory class could then serve public traffic under a qualification never exercised on that hardware or mode\. That risks wrong outputs or an incorrectly trusted build, which T\-054 and T\-056 treat as limits of attestation\. The threat model does not describe this declaration\-derived qualification path or the new \`cluster\_runtime\` release registration\. It should record that parity evidence does not cover the applied scope, and name who may change the declaration\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5

### MEDIUM: Release\-registered cluster\_runtime now mints public\-traffic approvals, grants and parity qualifications; threat model does not cover it
[docs/reference/configuration\.md:924](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/2071bbd79fe1ab24d49c8ce1321afe98c3d8989b/docs/reference/configuration.md#L924) · A-005, A-017, T-052, T-054

The new text says a signed release posts \`cluster\_runtime\` to \`POST /v1/releases\`, and the coordinator derives cluster approvals, pair\-serving grants and parity qualifications from it\. Qualifications for GLM\-5\.3\-Flash and Qwen3\.8\-27B are declared by the build \(\`ClusterPublicModels\`\)\. Their evidence is an owner decision plus a document hash, not cross\-cable records, and the docs say no M5 Ultra pipeline run and no GLM TP record exists\. The coordinator applies a promotable record to the whole mode family on any numerics classes, cuts and shares, so public traffic is admitted on any Apple silicon pair\. Whoever can call the release API \(A\-005\), or whoever controls a release's declaration, can now create public\-serving qualification as well as binary trust\. That weakens the independent\-qualification assumption behind A\-017, T\-052 and T\-054, and the threat model has no entry for this derivation path\. The control is outside the supplied evidence, so the coordinator\-side authorization of \`cluster\_runtime\` is unverified\. Fix: update A\-005, A\-017 and T\-054 to cover release\-derived qualifications, and confirm the coordinator requires independent approval of the \`cluster\_runtime\` block rather than trusting the release key alone\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5

### MEDIUM: Release registration now self\-derives cluster approvals, serving grants and public parity qualifications
[docs/operations/provider\-release\.md:653](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/2071bbd79fe1ab24d49c8ce1321afe98c3d8989b/docs/operations/provider-release.md#L653) · A-005, A-016, A-017, T-054, T-056, TB-011

The new Cluster Runtime Facts flow \(head lines 649\-668\) makes \`POST /v1/releases\` carry \`cluster\_runtime\`\. A coordinator derives that build's cluster approvals, pair\-serving grants and public\-traffic parity qualifications from it\. The model list comes from the build's own \`ClusterPublicModels\` declaration and qualification records\. The doc states that no operator posts approvals, grants or public qualifications per build\. It also says qualifications apply to each declared family on any Apple silicon pair: "the declared placement names the evidence, not a limit\." This removes a separate human approval for public cluster serving\. Holding the release key \(A\-005\) plus repository write access becomes enough to obtain public routing\. A\-017 instead describes qualifications as independently approved, separate from release publication\. Trigger: a build whose source adds a model to \`ClusterPublicModels\`, or a catalog/CDN entry that changes \`input\_modalities\`, would gain public pair routing and media admission on the next release with the variable on\. That pair could be untested hardware\. The threat model \(TB\-011, A\-016/A\-017, T\-054, T\-056\) has no entry for cluster approvals or this derivation\. Fix: add a threat entry for release\-derived cluster authorization, its trust inputs \(self\-declared list, catalog/CDN metadata\) and the bounds/eviction behavior\. Alternatively, keep an independent approval gate for public qualification and limit qualifications to the evidenced hardware\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-opus\-5\.5

### MEDIUM: Release\-carried parity qualifications admit public cluster traffic without independent cross\-cable evidence
[docs/reference/configuration\.md:990](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/2071bbd79fe1ab24d49c8ce1321afe98c3d8989b/docs/reference/configuration.md#L990) · A-005, A-011, A-017, T-007, T-054, TB-011

Head lines 923\-936 and 965\-993 say a signed release now sends \`cluster\_runtime\` in \`POST /v1/releases\`\. From that block, the coordinator derives the build's cluster approvals, pair\-serving grants and parity qualifications\. For declared models the qualifications are fixed by the build: \`promotable=true\`, \`diverged=false\`, a constant \`qualified\_at\`, and evidence that is only the hash of an owner\-decision report\. The coordinator then applies them to the whole mode family on any numerics class, cut and share split\. Line 992\-993 admits that GLM\-5\.3\-Flash has no tensor\-parallel cross\-cable record and that neither model ran pipeline on two M5 Ultras\. So whoever holds the release key \(A\-005\) can publish a build that grants itself public pair\-serving qualification\. This moves qualification from durable, independently approved records \(A\-017, T\-054\) into the release\-publication channel\. It also widens public exposure to shapes that never passed parity, weakening the T\-007 output\-integrity argument\. Trigger: a release with the environment variable on is registered, and the coordinator accepts the block\. Impact: public consumer traffic is routed to untested pair placements\. Fix: keep parity qualification separate from release registration, with independent approval and cross\-cable records per numerics\-class combination\. Alternatively, record this explicitly in the threat model as an accepted risk under A\-017/T\-054/TB\-011\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-opus\-5\.5

### LOW: Release registration now said to derive cluster approvals, pair\-serving grants and parity qualifications; threat model lacks this path
[docs/reference/configuration\.md:925](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/2071bbd79fe1ab24d49c8ce1321afe98c3d8989b/docs/reference/configuration.md#L925) · A-005, A-011, A-017, T-052, T-054, TB-011

Head lines 923\-931 now say a signed release's POST /v1/releases payload may carry a \`cluster\_runtime\` block\. A coordinator that accepts it derives that build's cluster approvals, pair\-serving grants and parity qualifications\. Before, an operator copied the digests into the operator approval file\. So the release\-registration credential \(A\-005\) and release publication now decide pair\-serving permission, not only binary\-hash trust \(A\-011\)\. The threat model keeps durable qualifications independently approved and separate from release publication \(A\-017, T\-054\), and TB\-011/T\-052 deny serving permission to evidence that is not an authorization\. None of these entries covers cluster\-pair grants derived from release payloads\. Trigger: anyone who can register a release, or a compromised release lane, publishes cluster\_runtime digests for an unqualified helper or worker\. Members whose local facts match would then be offered a pair \(lines 931\-936\)\. This is a documentation claim about platform\-owned backend behavior and was not verified here\. Fix: add the cluster\_runtime release path to the threat model \(A\-005/A\-017/T\-054\)\. State whether derived parity qualifications stay separate from release\-key authority and need independent approval\. Confirm the platform enforces that separation\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-opus\-5\.5

### MEDIUM: Release payload now carries parity qualifications and pair\-serving grants, merging publication with qualification
[docs/reports/2026\-10\-31\-public\-cluster\-models\.md:126](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/2071bbd79fe1ab24d49c8ce1321afe98c3d8989b/docs/reports/2026-10-31-public-cluster-models.md#L126) · A-005, A-011, A-017, T-054, TB-011

The new evidence record \(lines 101\-105, 122\-128\) says each signed release's \`cluster\_runtime\` facts carry pair\-serving grants and parity qualifications\. A coordinator that derives approvals from releases then derives the grants and qualifications from them\. The changed configuration\.md cluster\-runtime section says the same\. This makes release registration \(A\-005, A\-011\) the source of public cluster qualification \(A\-017\)\. The threat model treats qualification as independent of release publication \(T\-054, TB\-011 durable qualification\)\.  The stated evidence is weaker than what is declared\. Lines 34\-35 say each family is qualified on two M5 Ultras, but line 68 says no pipeline run on two M5 Ultras exists\. GLM\-5\.3\-Flash has no tensor\_parallel\_v1 record \(lines 84\-87\), and its only pipeline record uses cut 39, not the declared cut \[22\]\. The qualification therefore rests on an owner quote and the SHA\-256 of this document\.  Trigger: anyone able to publish a release, or a build whose ClusterPublicModels declaration names this file, gets public cluster serving grants for both modes without per\-geometry durable qualification\. Impact: unqualified pair configurations could serve public traffic, including media in TP\.  Fix: keep the coordinator's durable qualification approval separate from release\-carried facts, require passing records per declared mode, cut and schedule, and update A\-017, T\-054 and TB\-011\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-opus\-5\.5
